failure: report console access unavailable; do not change VM or choose another port
owner: existing host Lima boundary plus narrow nonprivileged SSH forward adapter
readiness: guest platform /api/ready and host port available
ssh_endpoint: read from identity-checked existing Lima instance at execution
start_argv_contract: SSH -N with ExitOnForwardFailure and LocalForward; no remote command; endpoint obtained from existing instance metadata
vm_identity: existing checked configuration digest; never replace VM
